conv2d_resample_plain_convolution: run conv2d_resample with default up=1 and down=1 to perform a standard 2D convolution on a tensor
conv2d_resample_upsampling: use conv2d_resample with up=2 to upsample a 4D tensor by a factor of two before convolving
conv2d_resample_downsampling: use conv2d_resample with down=2 to downsample a 4D tensor by a factor of two after convolving
conv2d_resample_with_filter: call conv2d_resample with a precomputed low-pass filter tensor f to apply filtered upsampling or downsampling
conv2d_resample_grouped_convolution: use conv2d_resample with groups=4 to perform grouped 2D convolution on a tensor with optional resampling
